rule: ABSENT TOPIC = NO STANCE (precedent: migrations 1520/1521). A topic counts as absent only when its vocabulary occurs ZERO times in the RAW HTML of every page the stance cites — navigation, sidebars and infoboxes all count as present, so the test is strictly more conservative than searching the article body and is immune to extraction error.
method_note: An earlier extraction-based pass reported 109 absent rows; it sliced Ballotpedia at the first "See also" and discarded the article body, and searched for the attribute mw-parser-output in tag-stripped text. That pass was discarded. This raw-HTML pass returns 82.
